frozen_contract.alphabet_rule: DNA as stored; encode() aliases U->T; IUPAC native; no <unk>
frozen_contract.batching_rule: sorted by (len, hash); BATCH=8; shard boundaries at multiples of 8
frozen_contract.layer: final encoder output (the model's returned representation)
frozen_contract.orientation_rule: sequence_oriented as stored; all placements orientation_corrected
frozen_contract.pooling: unweighted mean over real residue/nucleotide tokens, fp32 accumulate

token_layout: per-shard tokens.npy, ragged; use manifests/rinalmo_giga_v1_tokens_index.tsv -> (shard, offset, length)
